task_description: Build the Class AId MVP: integrate Supabase (PostgreSQL + pgvector + Auth + Storage), Groq (Llama 3.1 70B for LLM), and Cloudflare Workers AI (BGE-base for embeddings) into the existing frontend prototype. Convert D1 schema to PostgreSQL, rewrite all Pages Functions to use real services, add authentication, write unit tests, and create deployment/migration documentation.

verification.summary: TypeScript typecheck passes. Static export build succeeds (out/ directory). All 56 unit tests pass (readiness engine: 19, groq client: 9, validation: 28). Tests exercise real logic and would fail if code reverted. No Docker in this project (Cloudflare Pages deployment). Review fixes applied: JWT auth, shared engine, idempotency, chat classification, real insights queries, upload format validation.
